:::{#def-pearson-r}
#### Pearson correlation coefficient

The **Pearson correlation coefficient** of $n$ paired observations
$(\predvar_1, \outvar_1), \ldots, (\predvar_n, \outvar_n)$ is:

$$r \eqdef \frac{\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})}
{\sqrt{\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \bar{x})^2} \sqrt{\sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})^2}}$$

It is defined when neither variable is constant,
so that both sums of squares are positive.
:::
